place.name: Cueva del Guácharo National Park
place.description: The Guácharo Cave National Park (Spanish: Parque Nacional Cueva del Guácharo) is located 12 km (7.5 mi) from the town of Caripe, Monagas, Venezuela. It has as its centerpiece a large limestone cave, Guácharo Cave, which is the longest cave in Venezuela.
